name: erp-platform
description: Enterprise ERP: containerized multi-tenant ERP platform
comment: Docker is the supported way to run this stack, see the Makefile. The scripts below are a fallback for working without a container runtime, and they require MongoDB (as a replica set) and Redis to already be running locally.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build

comment:lint-staged: Formatting only. ESLint is not run here because it would have to boot two separate project configs on every commit; CI owns the lint gate.
